def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df = df.drop_duplicates()

    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df.loc[~df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']), 'sex'] = pd.NA

    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 100000
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000

    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce').abs()

    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    return d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
